payload.text: Synthesis check: 4 frozen operational hypotheses retain explicit falsification conditions. Scientific novelty has not been established.
Resource check: 1920 declared work units; each process has a 120s wall-time ceiling. No paid resource is authorized.
Rival check: predictions must include every rival. Their expected information is conditional; an impossible outcome rejects the supplied model set.
Formal check: alpha 0.05 is split across 8 fixed endpoints. Confirmation uses disjoint seeds; no optional stopping is permitted.
